records.assessment_scope: V.S. Industry Berhad group: concentration of revenue among three major customers in the financial year ended 31 July 2025

measure.name: Share of consolidated group revenue from disclosed major customers A, B and C
measure.definition: Calculated as (RM1,222,963,000 + RM548,554,000 + RM735,332,000) / RM3,787,833,000 * 100, rounded to two decimal places. The company identifies these three customers as each contributing at least 10% of group revenue.

source.licence_notes: Redistribution terms not independently verified; concise attributed summary and source link only.

limitations: This is V.S. Industry's downstream customer revenue concentration, not the percentage of Dyson's purchases sourced from V.S. Industry or the supplier's own sourcing concentration.

The annual report anonymises the customers; it does not identify any of A, B or C as Dyson. The Malaysia operating segment includes branches in Singapore and the Philippines; these customer revenues are not proof that all production occurred at a Malaysian facility.

The fiscal year begins before the study window. The measure aggregates the full year and cannot be restricted to the part inside the window; it is not evidence that the same shares applied each day or in later years.
The group's name is a supplied search target, but no graph entity, current supplier relationship, specific product, customer order or shipment has been verified. This is not a disruption probability.
Publication date follows the annual report submission announcement: https://www.klsescreener.com/v2/announcements/view/10725325.

approximations.basis: Disclosed later: the figure exists only once reported, so known from source.published_at, not the start of the observation period (plan section 5.2, rule 3). Checked 2026-11-15: Bursa announcement of the annual report submission dated 28 Nov 2025.

search_window.note: The fiscal-year observation period for retrieval; it includes months before the study window and does not imply a continuous disruption or current exposure.

records.assessment_scope: Global semiconductor foundry market revenue in the fourth quarter of 2025

measure.name: TSMC share of foundry market revenue
measure.definition: TrendForce's estimated global foundry revenue market share for TSMC in fourth quarter 2025; a revenue share, not a share of wafer volume or manufacturing capacity.

source.licence_notes: Redistribution terms not independently verified; concise attributed summary and source link only.

limitations: Global foundry revenue is a broad market measure influenced by product mix and prices; it is not a direct measure of all chips, mature-node capacity, or any particular appliance component.
TSMC is a Taiwan-headquartered company, but the percentage is not Taiwan's geographic share and does not establish that all TSMC manufacturing occurs in Taiwan.
This is electronics industry context, not evidence that TSMC supplies Dyson, a listed case-study supplier, or a specific chip or shipment. No shortage or interruption is inferred.

approximations.basis: Disclosed later: the figure exists only once reported, so known from source.published_at, not the start of the observation period (plan section 5.2, rule 3). Checked 2026-11-15: TrendForce press release dated 12 March 2026, reporting 4Q25 shares.

search_window.note: The reported calendar quarter for retrieval; not a continuous disruption, recovery period, or a verified current market share.

records.assessment_scope: Estimated share of global maritime oil flows transiting the Strait of Malacca in the first half of 2025

measure.name: Share of global maritime oil flows through the Strait of Malacca
measure.definition: Bernama's report of the US Energy Information Administration estimate for first-half 2025 maritime oil flows; the reported transit volume is approximately 23.2 million barrels per day.

source.publisher: Bernama via Malay Mail, reporting US Energy Information Administration estimates
source.licence_notes: Redistribution terms not independently verified; concise attributed summary and source link only.

limitations: The share concerns seaborne oil, not containerized appliance shipments, all maritime trade, a particular fuel purchase or a named supplier's route.
The direct EIA page retrieved during review did not expose the numerical table; the percentage is attributed to the EIA through Bernama, not independently verified from its original table.

Malaysia and Singapore indicate nearby case-study geography, not a claim about territorial jurisdiction or a verified port call. Alternative shipping routes exist; no actual closure, delay or supplier exposure is established.
This is a half-year estimate, not a daily reading, incident probability, or recovery duration.

approximations.basis: Disclosed later: the figure exists only once reported, so known from source.published_at, not the start of the observation period (plan section 5.2, rule 3). Checked 2026-11-15: Malay Mail article first published 6 April 2026, reporting 1H25 EIA estimates.

search_window.note: The first-half 2025 observation period for candidate retrieval; not a disruption interval or evidence of any case-study shipment.
